jobs.title: R&D Lab Technician
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5 years of experience as an electro-optical lab technician, preferably in the medical device industry or a related field Associate degree or equivalent certification in Electrical, Optical, or Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Technology, or a related field (BSc is a plus) Strong background in electronics and optics, including assembly techniques, soldering, wiring, alignment, adhesives, and mechanical integration
